{{Quote|He was trained in the Jedi arts. My only conclusion can be that it was&hellip; a Sith Lord.|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="Movie">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
A [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] '''duel''' on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] took place on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Maul was sent by his master, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], to retrieve [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], who managed to escape the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] Sith sponsored [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade of]] her home planet and take temporary refuge on Tatooine under Jinn's protection.

By backtracing transmissions from the Queen's [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship|royal starship]], Maul successfully tracked the starship and its crew to Tatooine, where he dispatched probe droids to confirm their presence. Maul ambushed Jinn as he prepared to load his new unofficial apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], onto the Queen's starship, which was due to depart for the [[Coruscant/Legends|galactic capital]]. Jinn managed to hold off Maul long enough for the ship to take off. The sudden appearance of Maul enlightened the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to the reemergence of the [[Sith Order]], who were thought destroyed for almost a thousand years.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Tatooine is sparsely populated. If the homing trace is correct, I will find them quickly, Master.''"<br />"''Move against the Jedi first. You will then have no difficulty in taking the Queen back to Naboo to sign the treaty.''"<br />"''At last we will reveal ourselves to the Jedi. At last we will have revenge.''"<br />"''You have been well trained my young apprentice. They will be no match for you.|Darth Maul and Darth Sidious|<ref name="Movie" />}}
After the Boonta Eve podrace and the acquisition of the hyperdrive parts for the Queen's starship, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were making their way to the ship. Along the way, they encountered one of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|probe droids]], which Qui-Gon destroyed. Inspecting it, Qui-Gon realized they were being followed, and they began to hurry for the ship.<ref name="PMn" /> During their run, they were attacked by three more probe droids, which were equipped with small laser guns, but Qui-Gon quickly destroyed them.<ref name="PMvg" /> Meanwhile, another of the surviving probes notified Maul of the Jedi's presence, and the Sith Lord hurried to intercept. What occurred next was the first recorded encounter between the Jedi Order and the Order of the Sith Lords in over a thousand years.

==The duel==
{{Quote|Qui-Gon's in trouble.|Quarsh Panaka|<ref name="Movie" />}}
[[File:JedivsSith.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] vs. [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]
As Anakin and Qui-Gon ran for the ship, mere yards away, Jinn sensed Darth Maul's approach. Turning around to encourage Anakin to pick up the pace, he saw Maul bearing down on them on his speeder bike.<ref name="PMn" /> Anakin quickly obeyed Qui-Gon's command to drop, just in time to avoid being skewered by Maul's speeder. As the speeder closed in on Qui-Gon, Maul leapt off the bike at the Jedi, attacking before his feet had even touched the ground. Surprised by the Sith's speed and ferocity, Jinn barely managed to block the attack. As Maul landed, he quickly followed up with an overhand, which Jinn deflected before attacking himself. As Maul blocked Qui-Gon's blow, Jinn ordered Anakin to get onboard the ship and tell them to take off.

As Anakin did so, Qui-Gon attempted to launch his own offensive, but Maul easily brushed off his overhand and unleashed his own frenzy of attacks. Jinn was viciously driven back, barely able to protect himself, as his own [[Form IV/Legends|style]] possessed a weak defense, especially against Maul's [[Form VII/Legends|furious lightsaber technique]]. Despite his own valiant efforts, Qui-Gon simply could not find an opening.<ref name="PMn" />

When Anakin boarded the ship and informed the crew of the situation, they attempted a rescue, flying low towards the fight with the boarding ramp lowered. As Qui-Gon blocked a leaping slash from Maul and countered, he saw the ship approaching. Disengaging from the Sith, Qui-Gon quickly leapt aboard, getting inside just as the hatch closed and the ship accelerated. As the Nubian streaked for the heavens, Maul was left fuming on the desert floor.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Go with the Queen to Naboo and discover the identity of the dark warrior. This is the clue we need to unravel this mystery of the Sith.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Movie" />}}
[[File:TheOneThatGotAway.png|thumb|right|150px|Maul watching his quarry escape.]]
Later, Qui-Gon told his apprentice, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], that the mysterious stranger was definitely after the Queen. He also mentioned that the attacker was well trained in the Jedi arts, leading the Jedi Master to believe he was a Sith Lord. Qui-Gon later reported the incident to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], and after the Blockade of Naboo was over they realized that this warrior was no doubt a Sith.

The seeds for the revenge of the Sith were finally laid that day. Darth Maul later avenged his loss at the Duel on Tatooine when he murdered Qui-Gon Jinn in a [[Invasion of Naboo#The battle for freedom|lightsaber duel on Naboo]], which took place during the retaking of [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]]. Maul was later defeated by Kenobi and believed to have died in the process, having been sliced in half and falling down a seemingly endless chasm. However, it was his hatred of Kenobi that kept him alive and he somehow escaped Naboo, ending up on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] for [[20 BBY/Legends|twelve years]] until he was found by his brother, the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The scene where we first get a confrontation between a Jedi and a Sith― I wanted it to be very abstract, you know, not deal with it. The end of the movie― The climax of the movie is the confrontation between these two characters, so I didn't want to give it away at this point. So I did it with a lot of swirling robes and flashing swords and kicking up a lot of dust but not actually seeing the fight.|George Lucas|<ref name="Commentary">{{Film|I}} audio commentary</ref>}}
This is the first lightsaber duel was the first fight showing both the Jedi and Sith in their prime. One of George Lucas's major objectives for the prequel trilogy was to make the lightsaber fights "faster and more intense." This duel was shown early and was made short to give the viewer a small taste of what was to come.

Qui-Gon Jinn's encounter with the probe droid was originally filmed, but it ended up [[Content cut from Star Wars|cut]] for time, which resulted in a slightly disjointed transition showing Anakin and Qui-Gon running back to the ship when they had earlier been seen walking calmly to their destination. This scene was, however, retained in the novelization, as well as included in the DVD version under the name "Farewell to Jira".
